subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable session metadata policy should replace inline `systemPromptReport` copies for retained session rows?
rationale: The code can clearly reproduce the remaining per-row report retention, but the fix must choose what prompt-report details remain durable, what is recomputed or stored out of line, and how existing warning-dedupe state survives upgrades.

options.title: Lightweight row plus preserved dedupe
options.body: Persist only the minimal warning-dedupe/current-summary state in session rows and move, truncate, or recompute bulky report sections with migration or compaction coverage.

options.title: Out-of-line report blobs
options.body: Store full reports by content hash or session-scoped blob while rows keep references, accepting a new durable artifact lifecycle to manage cleanup and repair.

options.title: Keep inline with stronger retention
options.body: Rely on pruning, caps, and cleanup to bound the index while accepting retained-row duplication for diagnostics and compatibility.

recommendation.title: Lightweight row plus preserved dedupe
recommendation.body: Persist only the minimal warning-dedupe/current-summary state in session rows and move, truncate, or recompute bulky report sections with migration or compaction coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history and session-store ownership signal for both the prompt-report feature and the affected persistence paths.
